newsitem.title: ESTONIA: NOMURA NOT CHALLENGING SHIPPING SELLOFF.
newsitem.headline: NOMURA NOT CHALLENGING SHIPPING SELLOFF.

text.p: Arbonale, the consortium that failed to win a tender to purchase the Estonian Shipping Company, is not planning to challenge the decision to award the tender to ESCO holdings, Nomura said on Friday.
"It is very premature to say there will be a legal challenge," Claus Mansfeldt, associate director of Nomura, told Reuters.
Nomura was one of the leading members of the consortium. Mansfeldt was responding to reports that the consortium was considering a legal challenge to the decision.
Mansfeldt said he was simply making sure that all the legal contracts had been fulfilled.
The Estonian privatisation agency awared the sale contract to ESCO Holdings on June 11.
Arbonale consortium was formed by Nomura, Hong Kong shipper Jinhui and Norwegian Navigator.
